verdicts.claim: Current Association/Icon identity is navy and yellow (also in uniform, rhythm, retail-behavior, hoops)
verdicts.note: Checked live: the 2025-26 rotation is a white Association with a purple gradient mountain, a purple Icon and a black Statement. The palette is Mountain Purple, Midnight Black and Sky Blue, and highlighter yellow was retired after 2023-24. Navy and yellow cues and hexes replaced in fanbase, uniform, retail-behavior and rhythm. That also settles the strategy risk about palette confusion.

verdicts.claim: Strategy risk and verify list treat the Association/Icon/Statement palette as unresolved navy/yellow versus purple
verdicts.note: The editor should state the palette as purple, black and sky blue (the team record's #4E008E agrees) and drop navy and yellow. Youth and core product should ship in purple and black.

verdicts.claim: Jazz Note logo is from the 1990s purple-and-teal era
verdicts.note: The Note is the 1979-96 purple, gold and green logo. The 1996-2004 look is the Mountain logo. Fixed in fanbase and underground; strategy already had it right.

verdicts.claim: Utah plays in the 'Pac-12 lineage' conference
verdicts.note: Utah and BYU are both in the Big 12 after the 2023-24 realignment.

verdicts.claim: Twilight outdoor concert series is a current summer tradition
verdicts.note: The Twilight Concert Series ended years ago. Replaced with Red Butte Garden summer concerts, which are long-running but still need a date check.

verdicts.claim: Central 9th and 9th and 9th are the same place
verdicts.note: Central 9th is around 900 South/200 West. 9th and 9th is 900 South/900 East. Split in art.json. Culture and strategy use "Central 9th" loosely, and the brief's focus line also conflates the two.

verdicts.claim: Sun Tunnels is salt-flats work alongside Smithson
verdicts.note: Sun Tunnels (1976) is Nancy Holt's work in the Great Basin desert, not on the salt flats.

verdicts.claim: Red Iguana is on Poplar Street
verdicts.note: The original is on North Temple in Poplar Grove. Neighborhood and mentions fixed.

verdicts.claim: Beer Bar is in the Gateway area
verdicts.note: It's downtown on 200 South, east of the arena, not at Gateway.

verdicts.claim: Craft Lake City DIY Fest is early August at Gateway
verdicts.note: It's mid-August at the Utah State Fairpark, matching the art and underground dossiers.

verdicts.claim: Thanksgiving-week Cup nights (Nov 24-25) involve Utah
verdicts.note: League facts confirm extra Cup nights on Nov 24-25, but each team plays only four group games and Utah's schedule is unknown. The strategy calendar assumes Utah plays Nov 24-27 and should hedge.

verdicts.claim: The Complex and Urban Lounge are in Central 9th
verdicts.note: Urban Lounge is on 500 East in Central City. The Complex is west of downtown near Gateway. Neighborhoods fixed.

verdicts.claim: Sugar Space Arts Warehouse is in the Central 9th area
verdicts.note: Checked live: it opened in Sugar House (Wilmington Ave, 2007), and a 2025 listing shows 132 S 800 W, downtown west. Whether it still operates is unconfirmed.

verdicts.claim: Takashi (Takashi Gibo) is operating downtown
verdicts.note: Checked live: no closure reports, but no recent dated confirmation either. Verify before naming him as a partner.

verdicts.claim: Skip beehives as tourist kitsch
verdicts.note: This contradicted the culture, uniform and retail dossiers, which use beehive geometry. Softened to skip literal kitsch only.

verdicts.claim: Ogden Union Station area is a Jazz watch-party gathering spot
verdicts.note: No known basis. Replaced with Historic 25th Street, Ogden, hedged.

verdicts.claim: 'The Mountain' is common fan shorthand (also retail-behavior, uniform)
verdicts.note: Plausible for the 1996 logo but unsourced. Wording softened. Don't use it as a slogan.

verdicts.claim: 'Utah Jazz Beehive' marks in recent branding; 'Jazz Nation'
verdicts.note: The Beehive mark claim has no known basis, so it was replaced with Jazz Bear. "Jazz Nation" is flagged as unconfirmed usage.

verdicts.claim: Delta Center URL delta-center.com
verdicts.note: The official site is deltacenter.com. Fixed in retail-landscape and retail-behavior.

verdicts.claim: Craft Lake City site craftlakecity.org
verdicts.note: The domain is craftlakecity.com.

verdicts.claim: Gail Miller chairs the Larry H. Miller Company
verdicts.note: The company is now branded as a Miller family business, so the role was softened.

verdicts.claim: Poor Yorick Studio is operating in the Granary area
verdicts.note: Unconfirmed. Location removed and status hedged. Don't list as a partner without a check.

verdicts.claim: Trent Call, Sri Whipple and Ben Wiemeyer are active Utah artists open to commissions
verdicts.note: These are real Utah artists as best recalled. Check availability and current work live before the strategy names them as partners.

verdicts.claim: Kilby Court, The Depot, Urban Lounge, The Complex, Metro Music Hall all still operating
verdicts.note: Long-standing, but venue churn is high. Check each.

verdicts.claim: Graywhale and Randy's Records and Diabolical Records still open at current locations
verdicts.note: Check locations and hours.

verdicts.claim: Era table 1996-2004 mountain, 2004-2016 navy, 2016-present navy/yellow
verdicts.note: The early eras (1974-96 Note, 1996 Mountain in purple, turquoise and copper) are solid. The 2004-2022 palettes and dates need a live check. Past City Editions 2017-25 are unlisted.

verdicts.claim: Ryan Smith drove the 2022-23 brand refresh
verdicts.note: Plausible. Confirm the date and credit.

verdicts.claim: Black Diamond, Kuhl, Voile and Skullcandy are headquartered in or near Salt Lake
verdicts.note: Kuhl and Voile are Salt Lake firms. Black Diamond changed owners in 2025, and Skullcandy is in Park City. Confirm HQs before co-brand outreach.

verdicts.claim: Nike Factory Stores in Lehi and Park City and Foot Locker at City Creek/Fashion Place
verdicts.note: The door list is from memory. Confirm which Nike-owned and athletic-chain doors exist.

verdicts.claim: General Conference weekends are first weekend of April and October
verdicts.note: A long-established pattern. Oct 3-4, 2026 has passed. Confirm the April 2027 dates (Easter is Apr 4, 2027).

verdicts.claim: Delta Center name returned 2023; Smith Entertainment Group owns Jazz and the Utah Mammoth shares the arena
verdicts.note: Long-established as of 2025, but CURRENT FACTS did not verify 2026-27 ownership or arena, so keep it in verify.

verdicts.claim: Oct 30 Nuggets at Jazz, West Group A, Dec 11 Cup final at Hinkle, Feb 11 deadline, All-Star in Phoenix, Apr 11/Apr 13-16 dates
verdicts.note: All match CURRENT FACTS.

verdicts.claim: Utah's home opener is Oct 30
verdicts.note: Oct 30 is confirmed as the first Cup home game, but the Jazz home opener could be earlier. Dossiers and strategy use "home opener" and "Cup Night" interchangeably.

verdicts.claim: Saturday Oct 31 I-15 pop-up after the Oct 30 Cup Night
verdicts.note: Oct 31 is Halloween. Rethink family traffic and whether a pop-up works.

verdicts.claim: Salt Lake City Stars are the G League affiliate under that name
verdicts.note: The name varies across dossiers (Stars, Salt Lake Stars). Confirm current branding.

verdicts.claim: Swig founded in St. George in 2010 by Nicole Tanner; Jell-O state snack; fry sauce from Arctic Circle
verdicts.note: Long-established facts.

verdicts.claim: Utah Starzz 1997-2002, Jimmer 2011, Stockton/Malone/Sloan eras, Finals 1997-98, Sloan died 2020
verdicts.note: Long-established history.

verdicts.claim: Living Traditions Festival in mid-to-late May is the reveal venue
verdicts.note: Festival timing and format have shifted before. Confirm the 2027 dates and that it still runs.

verdicts.claim: Utah Pride Festival early June and Utah Arts Festival late June at Library Square
verdicts.note: Recurring, but 2027 dates are unconfirmed.

summary: Utah's dossiers held up on history, geography and league dates; every date matches CURRENT FACTS. The big miss, caught in a live check, was a navy-and-yellow Jazz identity. It is Mountain Purple, Midnight Black and Sky Blue, with highlighter yellow retired. Fanbase, uniform, retail-behavior and rhythm are fixed, and the strategy risk note is the editor's to change. Still open: small venues, named artists, Nike and athletic doors, the 2004-2022 uniform eras, and whether Utah plays the Nov 24-25 Cup nights.
